validity.recommendation: Reclassify: this is NOT a natural-gas pipeline. It is a GASOIL (diesel) products EXPORT pipeline (Shuaiba pump station -> Khor Al-Zubair oil port). Fuel='Gas' is a mistranslation of the Arabic 'زيت الغاز' (zayt al-ghaz = gas oil / gasoil / diesel). Remove from GGIT (gas tracker) and move to GOIT as an oil/refined-products line, or flag as out-of-scope for GGIT.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: the pipeline is REAL and operating. Physically exists as a 46 km, 8-10 inch line from Shuaiba pump station (محطة ضخ الشعيبة, next to the Basra/Shuaiba refinery) to Khor Al-Zubair oil port; the Oil Pipelines Company (OPC) announced completion of its rehabilitation on 19 July 2024. Not a phantom. CLASSIFICATION (the finding): the row's OWN sole citation — al-mirbad (the OPC press announcement) — is titled and worded as 'أنبوب تصدير زيت الغاز (شعيبة - ميناء خور الزبير)' = 'GAS OIL / GASOIL (diesel) export pipeline (Shuaiba - Khor Al-Zubair Port)'. Body: 'أنجاز أعمال تأهيل أنبوب زيت الغاز (8 - 10) عقدة الممتد من محطة ضخ الشعيبة إلى ميناء خور الزبير النفطية ... بمسافة 46 كم ... زيادة الطاقة التصديرية لوقود زيت الغاز عبر المنفذ الجنوبي' = rehabilitation of the 8-10 inch GASOIL pipeline from Shuaiba pump station to Khor Al-Zubair OIL port, 46 km, to increase GASOIL FUEL export capacity via the southern outlet. 'زيت الغاز' is Arabic for gasoil/diesel — a refined liquid petroleum product, NOT natural gas ('غاز طبيعي'). Operator is the OIL Pipelines Company (شركة خطوط الأنابيب النفطية / OPC), GM Ali Abdul-Karim al-Mousawi. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION: S&P Global Commodity Insights (15 Aug 2024, 'Iraq's ambition to become refinery powerhouse moves closer to fruition') independently reports Iraq 'completed the upgrade of a gasoil pipeline from the Shuaiba projects depot next to the Basrah refinery to the southern port of Khor Al-Zubair to resume exports of gasoil ... first exports of the product since 2003, completed in July [2024]' — a fully independent English trade source describing the same line as a GASOIL line (S&P is paywalled and returns 403 to url_verifier, so it is not in proposed_refs, but it is a genuine second independent source). Separately, Arabic port-context sources confirm Khor Al-Zubair port exports 'زيت الغاز' gasoil 'containing 500 ppm sulfur' by tanker — a refined liquid product with a sulfur spec, definitively diesel, not gas. ORIGIN OF THE ERROR: Iraqi News Agency's English rendering also mistranslated 'زيت الغاز' as 'gas' ('Gas export pipeline from Shuaiba to Khor Al Zubair Port has been successfully rehabilitated'), which is almost certainly how the 'gas' misclassification entered GEM. DUPLICATE: not a GEM-internal duplicate of any Iraq gas roster row (P1850/P2234/P7435 also touch Khor Al-Zubair but are different lines); not in the GulfPub crude list either. It is a cross-commodity misclassification (gas<-products), not a within-tracker duplicate. SPECS (all confirmed by al-mirbad, but for a gasoil line): length 46 km CONFIRMED; diameter 8 and 10 inch CONFIRMED (sheet '10,8' in); endpoints Shuaiba -> Khor Al-Zubair port CONFIRMED; province Basrah CONFIRMED; status operating CONFIRMED (rehab completed, exports resuming). PipelineType 'transmission' (trunk export line, not gathering) is fine as a type but it transmits gasoil, not gas.

routes.corridor_desc: Roughly SSE ~46 km (routed length per source) across Basra governorate from the Shuaiba industrial/refinery zone southwest of Basra city to the Khor Al-Zubair port complex on the Khor al-Zubair estuary. Straight-line distance between the two named facilities is ~30-35 km, consistent with a 46 km routed pipeline. Both ENDPOINTS are named and mappable facilities; the intermediate alignment is NOT published, so the corridor is bounded by the two endpoints and the Basra->Khor Al-Zubair products/oil infrastructure corridor (parallels the Shuaiba-Khor Al-Zubair road/industrial belt) but the exact path is unverified.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the OPC announcement (al-mirbad), which names 'محطة ضخ الشعيبة' (Shuaiba pump station) and 'ميناء خور الزبير' (Khor Al-Zubair port). Coordinates are APPROXIMATE, defensible from these two well-known named facilities (Shuaiba refinery/industrial area SW of Basra ~30.42N,47.70E; Khor Al-Zubair port on the estuary ~30.19N,47.90E) — NOT precisely surveyed and NOT fabricated to false precision; treat as facility centroids. No waypoint could be independently sourced, so none is asserted (no fabricated intermediate coordinates). Suggested accuracy 'medium' reflects two named/mappable endpoints with an unpublished intermediate alignment. CAVEAT: this is a gasoil (products) line — for a routes-repo branch it should be handled on the oil/products side, not as a GGIT gas route.
